quick_facts.frontend_priority_note: Starting Sprint 4, frontend ships in parallel with — or BEFORE — backend. Every sprint must produce a demo-able UI increment.

content.vision: A Vietnamese-compliant Point-of-Sale and Electronic Invoice platform for retail stores. Every sale automatically produces a legally valid hóa đơn điện tử (Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC). All data is store-scoped, role-protected, and accessible via a real-time dashboard.
content.north_star_metric: Time from product scan to issued tax invoice < 10 seconds per transaction.

target_users.pain_point: Manual invoice creation is slow and error-prone
Tax reconciliation is done by hand from printed receipts
No real-time visibility of daily revenue or stock
No central system to manage multiple store locations

epics.title: Foundation — Auth & Multi-tenancy
epics.goal: Every user can log in with the correct role. All data is scoped to a store. Nothing leaks across store boundaries.
epics.completion_criteria: All staff can log in. Admin can manage users and stores. JWT + RBAC enforced on every endpoint.

epics.title: Product Catalog
epics.goal: Every store has a live, accurate product catalog with VNĐ pricing and VAT rates. Cashiers can look up products by SKU or name.
epics.completion_criteria: Admin/manager can create and manage products. Cashiers can search products. priceVnd stored as integer. VAT rate per product.

epics.title: Core POS Flow — Order + Invoice
epics.goal: A cashier can process a sale end-to-end: scan products → confirm payment → system auto-issues a compliant hóa đơn điện tử within 10 seconds.
epics.completion_criteria: Order lifecycle (pending → processing → completed) works. Invoice is auto-issued on order completion. Invoice number is immutable. Tax subtotals calculated correctly in VNĐ.

epics.title: Reporting & Tax Reconciliation
epics.goal: Accountants can export daily/monthly revenue and VAT summaries. Managers can view live dashboard stats.
epics.completion_criteria: GET /reports/daily returns revenue + VAT totals. CSV export of invoices for tax authority submission.

epics.title: Production Hardening
epics.goal: System is ready for real store deployment: E2E tests pass, Docker Compose verified, onboarding guide tested end-to-end.
epics.completion_criteria: Full Playwright E2E suite green (infrastructure from Sprint 4, suite completion in Sprint 12). docker compose up produces working system. Onboarding guide verified by a new team member.
epics.note: Playwright was pulled forward to Sprint 4 (P0 cashier E2E). Sprint 12 completes remaining flows.

epics.title: Demo-Ready Frontend
epics.goal: Every existing backend feature has a polished, navigable UI. A customer demo can run end-to-end in a browser with no hand-holding.
epics.completion_criteria: AppLayout + role-aware sidebar. Admin can manage stores and users. Any role can log in and reach their home screen.

epics.title: Reporting & Tax Reconciliation
epics.goal: Accountants can export daily/monthly revenue and VAT summaries. Managers can view live dashboard stats.
epics.completion_criteria: GET /reports/daily returns revenue + VAT totals. CSV export of invoices for tax authority submission. Manager dashboard with chart.

epics.title: Product Catalog Enhancements
epics.goal: Products are organized by category. Cashiers can scan barcodes. Managers can bulk import via CSV.
epics.completion_criteria: Category CRUD live. POS barcode input lookup by SKU. CSV import validated and imported successfully.

epics.title: Advanced POS & Refunds
epics.goal: Cashiers can apply discounts. Managers can process refunds. Split payment supported.
epics.completion_criteria: Discount % per line item. Refund triggers state completed→refunded. Invoice voided + replacement issued.

epics.title: Tax Compliance & Invoice Hardening
epics.goal: Invoices can be downloaded as PDF and exported as Circular 78-compliant XML for tax authority submission.
epics.completion_criteria: PDF download button on invoice detail. XML export endpoint passes schema validation.

epics.title: Multi-store Admin
epics.goal: Admins can compare performance across stores, reassign users, and configure stores centrally.
epics.completion_criteria: Admin cross-store revenue dashboard. Global user management with store reassignment.

epics.title: Real-time & Notifications
epics.goal: Managers see live order activity. Accountants get notified of pending invoices. POS gives feedback on payment confirmation.
epics.completion_criteria: WebSocket order feed on manager dashboard. Notification bell for accountant. Audio alert on POS payment confirmed.

sprint_schedule.title: Production Hardening

dependency_chain: auth → store → product → order → invoice → nav-layout → reporting → product-categories → discount/refund → invoice-pdf → admin-multistore → websocket → e2e-tests → devops-prod
content.frontend_note: From Sprint 4 onward: EVERY backend feature ships with a frontend UI in the same sprint. No more backend-only sprints. Frontend is a first-class delivery requirement.
content.frontend_priority_statement: Customer demo & testing readiness is the primary concern for Sprints 4-6. Navigation, role-aware landing, store/user management, UX polish, and reporting UI unlock the full demo scenario.

deferred_features.reason: Product has price/tax — no inventory tracking yet
Legal/operational dependency on Vietnamese tax portal
Manual SKU entry sufficient for demo

audit.author: vibe-product-owner
audit.note: Full 5-sprint roadmap created. MVP at Sprint 3. Dependency chain established.

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Roadmap extended from 5 to 13 sprints. Frontend-first rebalancing: Sprint 4 is Demo-Ready Frontend (AppLayout + nav + store/user UI). Sprints 5-6 close reporting. Sprints 7-9 catalog enhancements + advanced POS + tax compliance. Sprints 10-11 admin + real-time. Sprints 12-13 hardening + production.
